d:
The Milwaukee Brewers closed the show in style, putting on a championship masterclass to defeat the Tampa Bay Rays in Game 5 at Tropicana Field! Behind clutch late-inning plays and ice-cold execution under pressure, Milwaukee shut the door on Tampa Bay's fightback to clinch the series 4-1. With this historic victory, Milwaukee Brewers lift the World Series title and etch their names into baseball folklore!
